Content.zh:
更新日志 #22


大家好！

更多更新和更多修复！


<size=150%>版本 EA_0.27：</size>

- 修复了更新 EA_0.26 导致的的性能下降。
- 修复了导致一些橡木法杖的法术不能释放的bug。
- 修复了导致有松树的区域每tick都会产生一棵新的小松树的bug。
- 鸟巢事件现在危险性大大降低，您从中获得的蛋现在是鸟蛋而不是灰山鹑蛋。
- 松针现在可以用作燃料。
- 白桦糖浆、白桦酒和白桦树汁在用于调味时不是一次性的了。
- 现在将原木切成块时需要适当的耐力了。
- 实施了一项修复，用于移除由于bug而积累的所有小松树。
- 在被水浸林地中添加了柳树。
- 柳树和桦树现在会掉落它们对应的树枝。
- 干荨麻叶的品质损失速率下降了。
- “清理” 操作按钮在耐力低下时不再消失。
- 不再能将脂肪添加到脂肪中。
- 风亲和度现在在灵视选项卡中可见。
- 水袋不再自动增加其中的神奇茶。
- 白桦糖浆和白桦酒现在从火中取出后会正常冷却。
- 白桦糖浆、白桦酒和白桦树汁在加热时不再增加酒精含量。
- 更正了部分文本。
- 新发现的地点现在应当拥有该区域应有的所有树木，并且树木耐久为 100%。
- 修复了一个偶尔导致负重增加的旅行时间不一致的bug。
- 在坡道林地和乱石林地中清理动作能掉落石头和大石块了。
- 编织篓和其中的物品现在可以免受洪水侵袭了
- 修复了一个导致在河流地区建造的泥屋和其他建筑物的内容物不受洪水侵袭的bug。


目前就这些。
下次见！
Content.en:
Patch Notes #22


Hello everyone!

More patch notes and more fixes!


<size=150%>Version EA_0.27:</size>

- Fixed the performance drop introduced in patch EA_0.26.
- Fixed the bug which caused some Oaken Staff Spells to stop working.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Pine areas to spawn a new small Pine tree every tick.
- Bird Nest Event is now a lot less dangerous and the Eggs you get from it are now Bird Eggs instead of Partridge Eggs.
- Pine Needles can now be used as a Fuel.
- Birch Syrup, Wine and Sap no longer get spent fully when used for seasoning.
- Chopping Log into Pieces now requires the proper amount of Stamina.
- Implemented a fix that will remove all Small Pine Trees that have accumulated due to a bug.
- Added Willow Trees to Flooded grove.
- Willow and Birch Trees now drop their proper twigs.
- Dried Nettle Leaves now lose quality at a much slower rate.
- Clear action button no longer disappears on low stamina.
- It is no longer possible to add Fat to Fat.
- Wind Affinity is now visible in the Spiritual tab.
- Waterskin no longer increases the amount of Spirit Tea inside it.
- Birch Syrup and Birch Wine now properly cool down after being removed from the Fire.
- Birch Syrup, Wine and Sap no longer gain alcohol content when heated up. 
- Corrected some texts.
- Freshly discovered locations should now have all the trees in place already and Tree durability at 100%.
- Fixed a bug where Encumbrance would sometimes be inconsistent with how it increased travel time.
- Clear actions in Sloped grove and Rocky grove clear actions should again drop stones and heavy stones.
- Baskets and items inside them are now safe from floods.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the contents of Mud Huts and other structures built in river areas to be protected from floods.


That's all for now.
See you on the next one!
